terminal_name: Totisa Cueva Bermeja project (Port of Santa Cruz de Tenerife)
issue: NEW finding this batch: Totisa (the same sponsor behind the cancelled Las Palmas/Puerto de la Luz project) is separately pursuing an LNG storage + bunkering + captive on-site power (~70MW) + hydrogen project at Cueva Bermeja, Port of Santa Cruz de Tenerife -- a DIFFERENT site from both Granadilla and Puerto de la Luz. Still active/reported as of Aug 2025, not yet in GEM. Resolved scope doubt via two independent source checks that explicitly confirm this is NOT a regasification facility feeding the national gas grid -- it is a bunkering + captive-power-only design, materially different from the Las Palmas project (which had a grid-connected power plant and an explicit 'planta de regasificacion'). OUT OF SCOPE per the domestic-only/bunkering exclusion, consistent with the Los Barrios precedent. Not staged as new_terminal or monitor.
suggested_action: No action needed under current scope rules; resolved before staging per the never-stage-with-doubt rule.
